ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of Case Subject and Description fields when Case has been received via Salesforce to Salesforce.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Subject), ISCHANGED(Description) ), IsShared__c = true, Not(ISBLANK(ConnectionReceivedId)), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(ConnectionReceivedId), NOT(ConnectionReceivedId = null) ) ), NOT(Contains($User.FirstName, "Connection")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Subject and Description cannot be changed when case has been received via Salesforce to Salesforce.
